itemBodyHtml:
A spinner has 5 congruent sections labeled as shown. One side of a fair coin is heads, and the other side is tails.

The spinner is spun one time, and the coin is flipped. What is the probability that the spinner lands on 1 and the coin lands on tails?

Select the place on the number line that represents the probability.
